scope: Independent sessions per transport, authenticated same-user replacement, per-session asynchronous cleanup and bounded abandoned authentication.

checks: four dialects multiplex independent signing/encryption, scoped tree/file IDs, shared locks and rename across inactive opens; LOGOFF preserves the other session and its pending watch
interleaved SMB3.1.1 authentication exchanges retain separate preauthentication transcripts and independently verified encryption keys
failed new authentication preserves established sessions; valid different-user authentication cannot replace a guessed PreviousSessionId
same-transport replacement authenticates first, completes old watches under old keys and releases old exclusive opens while another session survives
cross-transport replacement drains only the matching old session and keeps its transport and unrelated sessions usable
four simultaneous reciprocal replacement races complete without holding transport gates in a cycle, and both new encrypted sessions remain usable
abrupt transport loss releases every session and all exclusive opens, including the inactive context
known-session requests signed or encrypted with a different session key are rejected at the transport boundary
sixteen-session transport bound rejects excess authentication without damaging peers; LOGOFF and expired abandoned handshakes release capacity
verified repeated logins do not exhaust the failed-authentication budget
signed NTLMv2 MIC authentication, UTF-16 create/read/write/flush/query/directory/close
QFid CREATE context agrees with internal file IDs across opens and distinguishes objects on one volume
authenticated srvsvc NDR32 share enumeration filters inaccessible and non-SMB shares

share access conflicts, exclusive/shared byte locks, rename with live handles, truncate and last-close deletion

session teardown cancels pending locks before discarding signing and encryption keys
peer disconnect removes a pending waiter before granting the next connection

ticket lifetime bounds SMB authority; Kerberos is independent of NTLM enrollment and existing mandatory-MIC NTLM authentication still works

expired authority reports NETWORK_SESSION_EXPIRED and renews the same open after an intervening management login
wrong proof and different-user renewal fail, release exclusive handles and complete signed/encrypted watches with NOTIFY_CLEANUP
fresh valid credentials cannot renew a revoked token or resurrect its exclusive open
LOGOFF during an incomplete renewal resets authentication state and permits a fresh encrypted session on the same transport
SESSION_SETUP for an unknown session does not abort another session's in-progress renewal or borrow its signing key
